ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition, Advertising and Computer Science/Advertising majors on Monday, November 15, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Technical Systems Management, French Commercial, Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, November 22, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. No exceptions will be made. BADM 320 is offered online every term with an enrollment limit. There are currently 30 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course. This is a core course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
